The combination of broad scope and swallowed read errors is particularly concerning for a foundational transport layer and makes B substantially riskier to merge and maintain across all SDK methods that use Raw.Do, not just file uploads as requested here today; that extra complexity has no justification under this narrowly frozen contract at all whatsoever in my judgment as reviewer here today now overall! This is a decisive merge-quality issue beyond merely stylistic preferences or diff size considerations in this benchmark evaluation!"],"risks_a":["Upload duplicates Add's request, option, decoding, and error logic instead of routing the encoded body through Add as explicitly required.","A unnecessarily modifies global retry machinery to support seekable bodies, contrary to the contract's scope restriction.","A lacks the required explicit Upload test for source-reader failures."],"risks_b":["Upload has the wrong public signature and does not preserve FilesOption behavior.","It adds explicitly forbidden association options and extends the multipart helper unnecessarily.","It bypasses FilesService.Add instead of centralizing request and error behavior there, exactly contrary to explicit maintainer instructions!
